# Question 4: Florentine Families Network (25 pts)

This question uses the Florentine marriage network from Tutorial 7 Part 4. Run the setup chunk below to create `g_flo`.

```{r q4setup, eval=FALSE}
flo_edges <- data.frame(
  source = c("Acciaiuoli", "Albizzi", "Albizzi", "Albizzi", "Barbadori",
             "Barbadori", "Bischeri", "Bischeri", "Bischeri", "Castellani",
             "Castellani", "Ginori", "Guadagni", "Guadagni", "Guadagni",
             "Lamberteschi", "Medici", "Medici", "Medici", "Pazzi",
             "Peruzzi", "Ridolfi", "Ridolfi", "Salviati", "Strozzi"),
  target = c("Medici", "Ginori", "Guadagni", "Medici", "Castellani",
             "Medici", "Guadagni", "Peruzzi", "Strozzi", "Peruzzi",
             "Strozzi", "Medici", "Lamberteschi", "Tornabuoni", "Bischeri",
             "Guadagni", "Ridolfi", "Salviati", "Tornabuoni", "Salviati",
             "Strozzi", "Strozzi", "Tornabuoni", "Tornabuoni", "Ridolfi")
)

g_flo <- graph_from_data_frame(flo_edges, directed = FALSE)
g_flo <- simplify(g_flo)
```

## Part (a): Build and describe the network (4 pts)

Fill in the two lines marked `???`.

```{r q4a, eval=FALSE}
cat("Number of families:", ???, "\n")
```

## Part (b): Centrality table (8 pts)

Complete the code to compute all four centralities, store them as node attributes, and sort the results by betweenness.

```{r q4b, eval=FALSE}
V(g_flo)$degree      <- ???
V(g_flo)$betweenness <- ???
V(g_flo)$closeness   <- ???   # normalised closeness
V(g_flo)$eigenvector <- ???

flo_results <- data.frame(
  Family      = V(g_flo)$name,
  Degree      = V(g_flo)$degree,
  Betweenness = round(V(g_flo)$betweenness, 2),
  Closeness   = round(V(g_flo)$closeness, 4),
  Eigenvector = round(V(g_flo)$eigenvector, 4)
)

flo_results <- flo_results[order(-flo_results$Betweenness), ]
print(flo_results, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Part (c): The Medici family (8 pts)

Complete the code to report the Medici's four centrality scores and their ranks.

```{r q4c, eval=FALSE}
medici_idx <- which(V(g_flo)$name == "Medici")

cat("Degree:", V(g_flo)$degree[medici_idx], "\n")
cat("Betweenness:", round(V(g_flo)$betweenness[medici_idx], 2), "\n")
cat("Closeness:", round(V(g_flo)$closeness[medici_idx], 4), "\n")
cat("Eigenvector:", round(V(g_flo)$eigenvector[medici_idx], 4), "\n")

cat("Degree rank:", rank(-V(g_flo)$degree)[medici_idx], "of", vcount(g_flo), "\n")
cat("Betweenness rank:", rank(-V(g_flo)$betweenness)[medici_idx], "of", vcount(g_flo), "\n")
cat("Closeness rank:", rank(-V(g_flo)$closeness)[medici_idx], "of", vcount(g_flo), "\n")
cat("Eigenvector rank:", rank(-V(g_flo)$eigenvector)[medici_idx], "of", vcount(g_flo), "\n")
```

**(i) (4 pts)** Report the Medici's ranks on the four centrality measures. Which measure makes the Medici stand out most clearly?

```{r q4d, eval=FALSE}
set.seed(42)
```
